display.purpose: Page titles and major section headers only.

title.purpose: Section titles within cards, table column groups.

body.purpose: All prose content. Max line length 65–72ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, table headers, nav items, badge text.

mono.purpose: All numeric financial data: prices, quantities, percentages, tickers, dates.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single primary action per view. Advisor Amber fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; background-color: oklch(0.62 0.12 58); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 75); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 100ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: oklch(0.56 0.11 58); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.62 0.12 58); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.12 58 / 25%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default secondary action. Transparent fill, quiet-text color.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; color: oklch(0.53 0.008 65); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: oklch(0.95 0.007 75); color: oklch(0.15 0.008 60); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.90 0.007 75); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 30%); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with visible border presence.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; background-color: oklch(0.98 0.008 75); color: oklch(0.15 0.008 60); border: 1px solid oklch(0.90 0.007 75); border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: oklch(0.95 0.007 75); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.62 0.12 58); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.12 58 / 20%); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary content container. Flat tonal surface with 1px ring boundary.
components.html:
Portfolio Overview
Holdings across all asset classes

Content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0.875rem; background-color: oklch(0.995 0.005 75); padding: 16px 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.15 0.008 60); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.15 0.008 60 / 10%); } .ds-card-header { padding: 0 16px; display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.53 0.008 65); } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 16px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Stroke-style input. Border visible at rest, amber on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; background-color: oklch(0.98 0.008 75); color: oklch(0.15 0.008 60); border: 1px solid oklch(0.90 0.007 75); border-radius: 0.625rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.65 0.006 65); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.62 0.12 58); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.12 58 / 20%); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link. Active state uses advisor-amber fill.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; height: 36px; border-radius: 0.625rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.53 0.008 65); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background-color: oklch(0.95 0.007 75); color: oklch(0.15 0.008 60); } .ds-nav-item--active { background-color: oklch(0.62 0.12 58); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 75); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item--active:hover { background-color: oklch(0.56 0.11 58); }

components.name: Signal Badge (HOLD)
components.description: LLM recommendation badge. Always carries text label — never color alone.
components.html: BUYHOLDSELL
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge--buy { background-color: oklch(0.93 0.06 142 / 20%); color: oklch(0.32 0.10 142); border-color: oklch(0.75 0.08 142 / 40%); } .ds-badge--hold { background-color: oklch(0.95 0.007 75); color: oklch(0.40 0.008 60); border-color: oklch(0.90 0.007 75); } .ds-badge--sell { background-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27 / 10%); color: oklch(0.42 0.20 27); border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27 / 30%); }

narrative.overview:
Zentri's interface is a private financial advisor, not a trading platform. The design is composed, unhurried, and authoritative — not because it is austere, but because it has already done the work. The palette is warm cream and ink, with a single amber accent. Surfaces do not compete for attention; information hierarchy does the work that decoration refuses to do.

The system rejects urgency as an aesthetic. No gamified color pulses, no live-ticker animations designed to simulate momentum. Zentri synthesizes; it does not dump. The interface distinguishes raw data from interpreted insight through scale, weight, and spatial placement — never through color or visual noise alone.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream canvas, ink-dark typography, one amber accent on active and primary elements only
Flat tonal elevation: surfaces separated by a 1px ring at 10% foreground opacity, never by shadow
Geist Sans for UI copy; Geist Mono exclusively for financial data (prices, quantities, percentages)
BUY/SELL/HOLD signals always carry label and color — never color alone
System theme: both light and dark modes are equally considered

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Advisor Amber appears on at most one active element per screen. Its rarity is the point. A screen saturated with amber has no advisor.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: BUY, SELL, and HOLD are never encoded by color alone. Every signal badge carries its text label. Color reinforces; it does not replace.

rules.name: The Mono Signal Rule
rules.body: Any numeric value requiring precision — price, quantity, percentage, date — is rendered in Geist Mono. The typeface switch is a semantic affordance.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No box-shadow appears unless a surface is genuinely lifted by user interaction. Use tonal fill or the 1px foreground ring instead.

dos: Do render all prices, quantities, and percentages in Geist Mono.
Do pair label and color on every BUY/SELL/HOLD signal — never color alone.
Do keep advisor-amber to one active element per view.
Do use the 1px inset ring (ring-1 ring-foreground/10) for card boundaries instead of shadows.
Do give sections room to breathe — cramped layouts undermine unhurried precision.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) on all body and label text.
donts: Don't use gamified color pulses, confetti, or visual urgency signals.
Don't use purple/teal gradients, glass cards, floating hero sections, or generic startup template aesthetics.
Don't use Bloomberg-style data density: walls of monospaced grids, no whitespace.
Don't use dark neon, glowing outlines, or matrix-adjacent visuals.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, alerts, or list items.
Don't use background-clip: text with gradients for any heading or metric value.
Don't introduce a second chromatic accent — Alert Red and Advisor Amber are the complete set.
